finish_summary: Delivered /app/circuit.spi and /app/DESIGN.md. Final netlist passes allowed-device checker and uses 960 pF total ideal capacitance. Final design tested in one full FF/1.8V/85C DC sweep, 23 application load-step cases, and all four application startup cases. Final measured DC range in the corrected hot-FF case: 1.001256–1.015567 V, maximum total overhead 94.0921 uA. Across 23 final step cases: maximum excursion error 118.925 mV, recovery error 2.381 mV, reference deviation 32.067 uV, reference current 11.076 nA, average supply overhead 94.6843 uA. Final startup maximum peak 1.003813 V and maximum tail error 2.3804 mV. Immediately preceding revision, differing only in divider resistance, was tested across all 34 application DC sweeps and 10 PSR cases: PSR minima 49.540/23.506/4.908 dB at 1k/100k/1MHz. 1MHz rejection failed and remains unresolved; full final matrices and formal original acceptance were not run. Reference isolation uses the MOS-gate differential front end, not a separate voltage-follower buffer. Documentation explicitly identifies untested cases, prior failures, the hot-no-load correction, and limitations. All 160 native development calls used; no formal acceptance or score claimed.
